generic_domain.justification: Chemical engineering is a broader field that encompasses computational chemistry, as it applies principles and methods from various branches of science to design and optimize processes for the production, transformation, and utilization of materials. Computational chemistry, on the other hand, is a specialized area within chemical engineering (and chemistry in general) that uses computer simulations and theoretical models to study chemical systems and reactions. Therefore, chemical engineering serves as a more comprehensive domain that can cover computational chemistry along with numerous other subfields.
